facts.fact: Bethany 天亮前回到家，Abel 还醒着，正躺在沙发上看 David Graeber 的 Debt: The First 5000 Years，见她这么早回来显得意外。
facts.anchor: He was lying on the couch reading Debt: The First 5000 Years by David Graeber. He closed the tome and sat up, surprised to see Bethany home before dawn.

facts.fact: Bethany 对 Abel 说 “I quit”，并把 Abel 的车钥匙丢进门口的咖啡罐里。
facts.anchor: I quit,” she said. She dropped Abel’s car keys into a coffee tin by the front door.

facts.fact: Abel 说他在 therapy（心理治疗）里谈过这件事、现在必须说出来；Bethany 以为他大概要提分手。
facts.anchor: I talked about it in therapy and it’s really important for me to say this right now

facts.fact: Abel 从左口袋掏出一个小盒子，单膝跪下。
facts.anchor: Abel withdrew a little box out from his left pocket. He got down on his knees.

facts.fact: Abel 打开盒子露出一颗钻石，说钻石是他母亲的，母亲听说他要送给她时非常高兴。
facts.anchor: Abel opened the little box, revealing a diamond inside. “It’s my mother’s,” he said. “She was so happy when I told her I was going to give it to you. Or, I suppose, offer it to you, if you’ll have me.

facts.fact: Abel 正式求婚：说 Bethany Peters 是他想共度一生、照顾一辈子的人，问 “Will you marry me?”。
facts.anchor: asking you to spend the rest of your life with me. Bethany Peters, I want to take care of you. Tonight, tomorrow, for our entire lives. Bethany. Will you marry me?

facts.fact: Bethany 支吾着 “I need to…”，跑向前门，从刚放钥匙的咖啡罐里抓回 Abel 的车钥匙，把手持戒指的准未婚夫留在地毯上。
facts.anchor: Then she ran for the front door, grabbing Abel’s car keys back out from the coffee tin she’d just dropped them in, leaving her would-be fiancé on the carpet, ring in hand.

facts.fact: Bethany 几分钟后驶回 I-35，逆着车流驶过 downtown Austin、去 GlobalVill HQ 的出口、Bat Bridge 和市界，把手机关着任 voicemail 堆积，离开这座城市和 Lone Star State。
facts.anchor: Within minutes, she was back on I-35, back speeding against traffic, headed past downtown Austin, past the exit she’d always take for GlobalVill HQ, past the Bat Bridge and city limits, driving…somewhere else.
